node.title: Renaming a file within a zip
node.author: palkia
node.doctext:
Hello.

I need to rename "members" (files within zip files), that have problematic characters for my OS (win xp).
I have constructed a simple (and long) regex rule to filter out such problematic chars, but then noticed that although the [http://search.cpan.org/~phred/Archive-Zip-1.59/lib/Archive/Zip.pm|zip module cpan doc] says it can be used to rename "members", it doesn't actually show how (as far as I can understand anyway).
I would like if possible to avoid a full overwrite of the entire zip file with its own reconstructed version, as I would probably have to run this over a large number of zip files in the near future.

Your thoughts ?
Thx
